peer-approval.description: Who approved the pull request that produced this commit

code-quality-gate.description: SonarQube quality gate of the analysis of this exact commit

secret-detection.description: Secrets TruffleHog finds in the files of this commit. Records where they are, never the secrets

secrets-path.description: Directory to scan, relative to the workspace (default .)

secrets-verify.description: true to ask each provider whether a secret found works (default false)

sca.description: Known vulnerabilities in the dependencies of this commit, found by Grype

sca-target.description: dir:<path>, sbom:<file> or file:<file> to scan (default dir:.). evidence.yml sets file: to the subject when given subject-artifact

sca-fail-on.description: Lowest severity that makes the result fail: critical, high, medium, low or negligible (default high)

test-results.description: What the tests of the build reported, read from its JUnit XML. Signed with the build key: the squad's build ran them

test-reports.description: Directory of JUnit XML reports. evidence.yml sets it when given reports-artifact

provenance.description: SLSA build provenance: which workflow, commit and run produced the artifact

provenance-attestation.description: GitHub's artifact attestation of the artifact's build provenance, signed with Sigstore, as gh verified it. evidence.yml has GitHub make it first

attested-file.description: The artifact. evidence.yml sets it to the subject it downloaded and hashed

attestation-signer.description: <owner>/<repo>/.github/workflows/<file> that must have signed the attestation. evidence.yml sets it to itself

custom.description: Anything a squad wants to declare itself. Signed with the self key, never platform-verified

predicate-file.description: Path to a file that holds one JSON object
